candidates.name: HM Land Registry Customer Care Review Report and Recommendations 2025
verified_facts: The official 2025 review states that red title boundary lines can be interpreted with a false sense of precision.
It describes general boundaries as preserving a zone of uncertainty around the red line.
It distinguishes general boundaries from determined boundaries.
semantic_limits: This review is contextual evidence about user interpretation and general-boundary uncertainty; it does not itself determine any parcel boundary.

candidates.name: OGC CoverageJSON Community Standard 1.0
verified_facts: CoverageJSON is an OGC Community Standard for encoding coverage data such as grids, time series and vertical profiles.
Its conformance target is the CoverageJSON format and JSON schema.
CoverageJSON separates domain, range, coverage and collection objects.
semantic_limits: CoverageJSON conformance is representation evidence only and does not validate EA terrain values, survey identity or vertical RMSE.

candidates.name: OGC API - Environmental Data Retrieval Standard 1.1
verified_facts: OGC API EDR supports CoverageJSON as an optional representation through content negotiation.
The standard separates API query behavior from the encoding chosen for a response.
CoverageJSON conformance checks the representation/schema, not the authority of the underlying observed values.
semantic_limits: API and representation conformance do not establish parcel-specific survey lineage or numeric terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: WCS CRS Extension 1.0
verified_facts: The adopted WCS CRS Extension allows a client to request coverages and subsets in CRSs different from the native CRS.
Supported output and subsetting CRSs are advertised by the service.
A requested output CRS can differ from the coverage native CRS.
semantic_limits: CRS transformation is processing; transformed output must not be treated as a native grid observation without explicit provenance.

candidates.name: WCS Range Subsetting Extension 1.0
verified_facts: The WCS Range Subsetting Extension retrieves selected components from the range of a coverage.
Range subsetting acts on the coverage range type and does not redefine spatial sampling geometry.
Range-component selection is distinct from scaling, interpolation and CRS transformation.
semantic_limits: Selecting a range component does not improve measurement accuracy or prove native spatial resolution.
